title: pi-chafa-banner configuration
description: Startup splash for the pi coding agent: an animated chafa-rendered gif at the top left, its info card below, the resource panel on the right. Every key is optional; a missing or invalid key falls back to the default.

version.description: Config format version. Currently 1; other values are read anyway with a warning.

path.description: Gif to animate. Absolute, or relative to the directory holding this file. '~' is expanded. Default: ~/Pictures/logo/v-3.gif, then the bundled assets/banner.gif.

fps.description: "auto" plays the gif at its own per-frame delays (recommended). A number forces a fixed rate, which makes a stride-sampled gif look accelerated.

stride.description: Keep every Nth gif frame; higher is smaller and faster.

chafa.description: Extra chafa flags, as one string (e.g. "--symbols block" or "-c 16"). Quote each token that contains a space. --probe, --animate and --clear are dropped: the first makes chafa wait for a terminal reply and steal pi's stdin, the second breaks framing, the third wipes pi's screen. The size (-s) stays authoritative.

width.description: Preferred total width of the splash block, in columns. Capped by the terminal and by maxWidth. Each of the two columns, and the chafa canvas, gets half of it minus the gap.

gap.description: Blank columns between the art/info column and the resource panel. The remaining width splits into two equal columns.

twoColumnMinWidth.description: Below this width the lower block stacks instead of splitting into two panels.

compactMinWidth.description: Below this width the splash degrades to three plain lines.

maxWidth.description: Hard ceiling for the splash block, whatever the terminal says.

lowerRows.description: Rows reserved for the panels below the image.

fields.description: Which facts the coding-agent box shows, in order.

sections.description: Which resource groups the right-hand box lists.

width.description: Preferred width of the resources box; 'auto' shares the row with the info box.

height.description: Preferred height of the resources box; 'auto' grows with the content.

maxLinesPerSection.description: Lines each section may use before its items get truncated.

enabled.description: false = do not install the header at all.

static.description: true = render one frame and never start a timer.

hidePiResourceList.description: true = remove pi's own [Context]/[Skills]/… listing below the splash.
